rules.description: EOP2 briefing document must include a 'Specific Regulatory Questions' section with at least one numbered question.
rules.resolution: Add a Specific Regulatory Questions section with clearly scoped, numbered questions for FDA.

rules.description: Primary endpoint in the Phase 2 results section must exactly match the primary endpoint registered in the protocol.
rules.resolution: Verify primary endpoint wording against the ACCESS II protocol and align exactly.

rules.description: Cardiovascular safety plan must be present for all GLP-1 agonist obesity programs.
rules.resolution: Add cardiovascular safety plan section addressing MACE monitoring and CV stopping rules.

rules.description: Proposed Phase 3 design must include sample size justification.
rules.resolution: Add sample size justification with power calculation parameters to Phase 3 design section.

rules.description: Background and rationale must reference unmet need in the target indication.
rules.resolution: Add explicit statement of unmet need in obesity to background section.
